purpose: Read-only inventory of candidate organization ownership and known Field Collector lineage before tenant/RLS design proceeds.

candidate.execution: Unified CLI ran in a disposable container on the candidate private network; current services/cli.py and services/mobile/tenant_preflight.py were bind-mounted read-only.

interpretation: The local candidate contains no location rows or inventoried lineage. This does not establish ownership status for the legacy, production, or any populated deployment.
limitations: Organization relationships are review evidence, not authorization or automatic owner assignment.
Counts cover listed direct relations only and do not prove complete downstream, export, or backup lineage.
Relation row counts can include one collection in multiple lineage tables and are not a unique-record total.
This report does not verify or enable row-level security.
